source: New shallow Git clone from the public repository
dependencies: New virtual environment; packages downloaded from official PyPI with no cache; requirements.txt installed including transitive dependencies
installation_note: A non-responsive local system proxy blocked the first attempt. NO_PROXY=* was set only in the installation process; system settings were not changed.
initial_clone_failure: With core.autocrlf=true, Git treated the ASCII-only sample PDF as text and changed its bytes. The original Git blob matched the reference hash. A committed .gitattributes binary rule fixed the issue; this record is from a second fresh clone.
limits: One Windows/Python environment. Automated provider responses are simulated; the saved-example check is offline, not new generation.
